facts.name: Lungwort
facts.notes: One of the first flowers of spring, pink and blue on the same plant, over silver-spotted leaves that brighten shade all season.

companions.why: Combines well with hosta and ferns; eye-catching near dark-leaved Heuchera, Pulmonaria or Brunnera; a backdrop for dark astilbe.
